summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Inside Ownership 100 ETF (OWN) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Inside Ownership 100 index. The fund tracks an index of 100 companies from the S&P 500, selected and weighted by insider ownership value as calculated by the index methodology. OWN was launched on Jun 3, 2026 and is issued by Corgi.

holdings.infoBox: OWN is an equity ETF with a total of 102 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 11.99%, Alphabet at 11.06%, Amazon.com at 8.62%, Meta Platforms at 5.63%, and Tesla at 5.22%.
